columns.name: most_expensive_order
columns.description: The most expensive order before discount applied the customer has made, with ties broken by the ascending order of the order number.

columns.name: has_made_orders_online
columns.description: Set to 1 if the customer has made orders online, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: highest_net_profiit_for_order
columns.description: The highest net profit before discount applied for an order the customer has made.

columns.name: avg_price_of_order_after_discount
columns.description: The average price of an order after discount the customer has made.

columns.name: quantity_of_orders_in_2018
columns.description: The quantity of orders the customer has made in 2018, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: has_been_applied_10per_discount
columns.description: Set to 1 if the product has been applied a 10% discount, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: percent_of_units_ordered_from_burbank_stores
columns.description: Of all units of this product ordered, the percent whose store is in Burbank.

columns.name: total_net_profit
columns.description: The total net profit of the product before discount applied , replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: number_of_orders
columns.description: The number of orders the product has, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: highest_net_profit_in_2019
columns.description: The highest net profit of the product before discount applied in 2019.
